sources.machineTiming: Havana-visible timing approved for deterministic NGH implementation

accepted: 300 ms turn with five subturn payloads

reservationContention.rule: ascending object ID reserves first; loser retries direct, CCW, then CW

avatarCollisionPhase: skip collision when stunned or invincible
scan active snowballs by ascending object ID at their pre-advance locations
remove all killed objects after the complete object pass

simultaneousHitOrder.rule: the ascending target avatar scans projectile IDs at pre-advance positions; damage resolves sequentially and the hit point precedes the knockout bonus
